It runs tool:read-post-calendar and answers {"from":"2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z","to":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","posts":[],"unscheduled":[]}

instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show what this person is posting between two times, and which drafts have no time yet, so a post can be given a time or moved to another", and give it from (The start of the span, like 2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00); to (The end of the span, after from); records (The person's post records, as the caller read them from a store ({ id, type: 'post', value }).).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-post-calendar and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give from and to (dates and times with their zone) and records (the person's post records).
